summary: Two Double Bedrooms · Available November 2022 · Spacious Apartment
description: Acorn Properties are pleased to welcome back to the market this spacious first floor apartment on Hawthorne Terrace, NE4. The property is furnished and situated with excellent transport links to Newcastle City Centre. The property briefly comprises of security door entry, Communal lobby entry hall, kitchen with white goods and stainless oven, separate living room, two double bedrooms and bathroom. The property is modern with neutral decor throughout. Viewing essential to fully appreciate. Call Acorn Properties today and speak with the Lettings Team today to arrange a viewing.
